name: SPARKD: Heroes Don’t Look Away
description: SPARKD Man braces against a semi-truck on a wet road to protect a tiny kitten. Emerald and gold hero colors, a flowing cape, and the message Real Heroes Don’t Look Away capture SPARKD’s spirit of kindness. The fourth approved artwork in SPARKD Creative Art. Created with AI assistance. Issuance policy: one NFT for this artwork, with no additional editions.
